correctness.rationale: For a binary prior \(\Pr(U=1)=q\), Bob's click channel has conditional probabilities \(0\) and \(a_pt\), so its mutual information is exactly \(h_2(qa_pt)-q h_2(a_pt)\). If \(\omega_1\preceq c\omega_0\), then every mixture \(\omega_s\) is the image of a Bernoulli coin of bias \(r_s^{(c)}\) under one fixed preparation channel, giving the stated \(J_c(q,t)\) upper bound by data processing. Averaging the two erasure branches and subtracting from Bob's information gives the displayed achievable private-information rate. A fresh high-precision evaluation at \(p=1/2,q=39/200,t=4/299\) gave \(0.0002101139266\ldots\), more than \(1.104\) times \(3\ln 2/10927\). The repository's exact rational-interval verifier independently certifies the sign.
residual_risks: The result is only an achievable rate for the fixed physical construction and measurement; it is not a capacity evaluation or optimizer.
